studies.title: Pei Xiu's six principles of map-making
studies.caption: Pei Xiu sets out scale, a rectangular grid, true distances and corrections for height and bends in roads.
studies.prompt: Birds-eye view of a third-century Chinese mapmakers worktable in Luoyang: brush-drawn rectangular grid with winding rivers and hills on a scroll, straightedge and cords, one hand comparing distances. Inkstone and brush, plain Han-Jin sleeves. No modern surveying tripod or printed graph paper.
